reviews.text: A google review cannot capture the degree to which I am grateful for and in awe of green paws, which is a company I've been using  to watch my my two cats for 10+ years. On more than one occasion, Green Paws has gone ABOVE AND BEYOND for me, including most recently when the pet sitter noticed a significant leak in my kitchen and Green Paws manager Robb heroically---and after hours---rescued my entire unit and mitigated significant potential downstairs damage (and documented everything meticulously). I am still speechless and shocked at the level of service Robb and Green Paws have provided and I cannot imagine using another service ever again. Truly the very very very possible people to work with.
Green Paws has the best team of people who love your pets like their own, and take the stress out of having to leave them for a day or while traveling. I always know my pup is in excellent hands!

Green paws and the whole team has been fantastic with Hachi Olaf and Luna They are always on time, incredibly reliable, and send wonderful photo updates and notes after every walk. I always come home to a happy, relaxed pup. If you need someone who truly cares about dogs and pays attention to detail, I couldn't recommend them more!❤️

I'm so grateful for Green Paws! I've been using their cat-sitting services for a few years now, and I am always blown away by the care and attention of their team. They send photos and fun updates while you're gone—you can feel that these are people who love animals and love what they do. Shout out to our most recent sitter Caroline! She was somehow able to bond with one of my cats who is famously shy and skittish.

I also can't say enough good things about their Operations Manager, Elise. She goes above and beyond to accommodate requests and has an encyclopedic knowledge of all the animals she cares for. If you're looking for caring and reliable sitters, Green Paws is your place.

Absolutely love Green Paws!  Everyone I've interacted with is kind, they communicate clearly, their scheduling app is easy to use, and my cat loves his sitter (which is no easy feat since he's afraid of people).  Green Paws also takes care of their employees, making sure they're paid a livable wage.  That does make their pricing a little higher, but it's well worth it.

I can't rave about Green Paws Chicago enough! My boy Astro absolutely ADORES them. They truly care about my boy and always take such amazing pictures! It makes my day seeing all the wonderful pictures and updates about his walk. I've been using them for a few years and couldn't be happier!

We have used Green Paws for several years now for regular walks and for vacations of up to two weeks. They treat our spoiled dogs just as we would and take great care to keep them safe and happy. We never worry when we are away. Green Paws walkers are professional, personable and they love dogs as much as we do.

We used Green Paws Chicago’s cat sitting services for an extended weekend (2 visits per day), and had a great experience. They were incredibly accommodating, especially given our situation. Robb answered our call late in the evening while we were scrambling to find a sitter after a last-minute cancellation, and went above and beyond to help us get set up quickly. We were able to complete the virtual screening and in-home interview right away, and their team matched us with a fantastic sitter, Caroline.

Caroline was wonderful with our cats. Beans can be very shy, but he ended up rolling around and really opening up to her (even taking his medication without issue). Our cats also have a specific feeding routine, and she followed it perfectly. We received consistent updates and photos that made us feel confident they were happy and well cared for. Everything was clean and the litter box perfectly taken care of when we got home, which we really appreciated!

I’d definitely recommend Green Paws to anyone looking for reliable cat sitting that truly listens to your pet’s needs!
Thank you, Frank!
Lovely service
I highly recommend Green Paws. The office is professional and the sitters are great and treat your pets like their own (shoutout to Kevin!). Thanks, Green Paws!

Thank you Green Paws Chicago for taking excellent care of our two cats while we were away for almost 3 weeks. The daily updates were very reassuring and the team is incredibly thorough and thoughtful. Highly recommend!

We've been very happy with the care our dog and cats have received from the Green Paws team since we started with them this summer.  Their communication with us is superb, and all 3 run to greet them when they arrive!

We have been SO happy with Green Paws! They are so quick and responsive, even we we need something last minute! We were  paired with Toan who is so kind and leaves so many photos and thoughtful messages when he goes to see our dog, Henry! My husband and I always look forward to them! Henry absolutely adores Toan! We are very grateful to have found Green Paws & their wonderful team!!

I have been using Green Paws for over 5 years for dog walking and dog sitting.  They are the most reliable and responsible  pet service organization I have ever utilized.  Their customer service is top notch including their ability to handle short notice requests.  I have been able to use the same dog walker during the entire time and he is the absolute best at what he does!  With my older dog, he was so helpful in monitoring any changes in routine/movements.  Their dog sitters are also wonderful, and I appreciate that you are able to set a preference on who you want to do the sitting if available.  The sitters have helped me out numerous times by staying later than expected when my flights have been delayed.  Also when my puppy broke her leg at 5 months, they were the only people I would trust to help - her dog walker was willing to carry her up and down the stairs for months and the sitters followed the complex instructions perfectly.

I cannot recommend Green Paws enough - they are the very best!

Green Paws has been a fantastic service for us when we have to leave our cat at home! They are extremely responsive and always take the best care of our cat. McKenzie usually takes care of him and she is incredible! But all of the caretakers we've had at Green Paws are great and our cat loves hanging out with them :)

I have had my baby girl Willow for 8 years and there have been so many times where a dog walker would have come in handy, but, based on experiences close friends of mine have had with walkers I was afraid to trust anyone other than family with my girl. A few months ago, I had no choice but to start seriously looking for someone new who could walk Willow and I came across Green Paws. After a virtual interview we set up a meet and greet with who would be Willow’s walker as well as another member of the Green Paws team. Meeting them in person and seeing their interaction with Willow sold me! Willow is a Pittie mix who has selective liking to people and reactive to most dogs. Another reason I was afraid of a walker- would they be able to handle her? Well, I know now that yes! Angela is our walker and she is amazing with Willow. Willow looks forward to her walks and is so excited every time she sees Angela. Angela is her new bestie! Everyone at Green Paws is so nice and accommodating too. Their system is easy to use and I love how they treat not only their clients but you can tell they care for their employees too. That’s always a good sign. Thank you Green Paws for giving me a reason to trust someone else with my baby girl! You have made my life easier and enriched Willow’s. If you’re in need of a walker or sitter, look no further. Green Paws gets 5/5 stars from me and probably 100/5 from Willow.

I am delighted to have the opportunity to leave a 5 star review for Green Paws; and particularly for my kitty care provider, Cassie A.
I was invited to my older daughter's house in Ohio for Thanksgiving.  My youngest daughter who usually cat sits while I am away was also going so I had no one to watch my 3 kitties.  My daughter had previously used Green Paws and suggested that I call them.  I first spoke to Katey who was so patient with all my questions. In fact, I called her so many times that she recognized my voice.  She walked me through the process, helped me determine which service would best meet my kitties needs and relieving the stress and anxiety I feel when leaving my fur babies. I decided to have a pet sitter stay overnight. The entire process from the virtual meet and greet with Katey to the in-person meet and greet with Cassie and Elise went exceptionally well.  Cassie went above and beyond in communicating with my each day I was gone.  She sent me tons of photos and provided explicit details about my kitties daily activities.  When I returned home, everything was in place!  My condo did  not look as though anyone had stayed in it for two nights!  Cassie is an exceptional pet sitter.
If you need a pet sitter, please pick up the phone and call Green Paws to schedule a service with them.  You will not be disappointed.

We had have great experience with both Pet Care Specialists and really appreciate the flexibility and communication. Our dogs have built grear rapport with PCSs, and we are much more comfortable traveling without them now.

We’ve been using Green Paws for over 3 years now and couldn’t be happier. They are reasonably priced, communicative, flexible and always available. We lead busy professional lives and their consistent ability to help us out last minute has been so incredibly helpful. Most importantly, our pups have loved their caregivers and they’ve been incredibly sweet and kind to our dogs. We couldn’t be happier with the service!

The entire team at Green Paws is the best! Each and every interaction with them over the past few years has been fantastic. Scheduling is a breeze, they are so easy to communicate with and quick to respond. We’ve had the pleasure of meeting and having several of the pet care specialists stay with our pups over the past few years. Each every member of the team has taken the best care of our dogs while we are away. We feel so at ease knowing they are in such good hands and always appreciate the photos and updates we receive. We couldn’t imagine anyone else to help us care for our dogs!

Green Paws is wonderful and I’m so glad we found them! They’ve been incredibly flexible and accommodating, and it’s always a relief knowing we can rely on them to walk and take care of our senior dog. Our dog walker Jonathan is so funny and kind, and I really value the comments and pictures that he leaves after every walk.

We are truly so appreciative of Green Paws and their service.  They have been nothing short of amazing!  All of our sitters have been wonderful with our two dogs.  Our chihuahua mix requires patience as he is avoidant, and a bit antisocial and aggressive with unfamiliar people.  All of the sitters have been interactive, consistent, friendly, and kind with our dogs, navigating around certain challenges with ease and visiting three times per day.  They provide plentiful photos, detailed updates, and ensure that the water and food are refilled.  We truly feel safe with this service, and we highly recommend them.

I entrusted my dog, Junebug, to this wonderful team while traveling, and the experience exceeded every expectation. Their communication was excellent, the attention to detail remarkable, and the genuine affection showed Junebug was clear from the daily photos and updates. It’s rare to find a service that combines professionalism and warmth so seamlessly. I returned home to a  happy, well-exercised, and clearly loved pup — I wouldn’t trust anyone else with her care.

Cannot speak highly enough of this service!!!  Everyone is lovely to work with.  Our dog, Wembley, loves all the walkers.  They handle last minute changes and requests when needed.  Truly - a great firm to work with!!

We love the Green Paws team and our sitter. We have two high-anxiety pups and it was almost impossible to leave them before we found Green Paws and Dani. Dani and the team are helpful, warm, friendly responsive and communicative. The app is easy to use, the team is always available and our trips now are stress free. We love getting their photos and updates. So grateful and highly recommend.

WE LOVE GREEN PAWS!
There are so many reasons to love this company, so let me bullet a few:
- their employees are dedicated, kind, and flexible
- they are responsive and understanding of requests and changing schedules
- they provide the service to the pets even when there is sickness or change from their employees
- they take care of their employees!

Personally, we have dogs that are leash aggressive and hesitant to welcome new faces, and Green Paws understands these needs. They take care to provide dog walkers who are adept and caring. I believe they really do care for our pups, and our household, and that is invaluable.

Oh, and our dog walkers take great pictures every day:)

Green Paws took care of my entire furry crew with professionalism and true compassion. After mainly using friends and family for pet care, it was hard for me to switch to a company. Green Paws made the process easy and informative which left me feeling reassured that my furballs would be in the best hands.

I’d rate these guys 10 stars if I could. I’ve been using Greenpaws for a while now and I couldn’t be happier with their service. You could never go wrong with this team! We had Sarah taking care of our dogs and they absolutely love her. We’ve loved the communication, the reliability, and the photos they send of my dogs after every visit. Highly recommend!

I have so appreciated Green Paws and their care of our dog Maggie! After a pretty awful sitting experience with a different service, I was looking for a company I could trust. The team is so responsive (I often feel bad because I can't respond as quickly as they do!) The platform for communication is clear, and the care has been great. Maggie is dog reactive, so we do in-home sitting - and I am so grateful for each sitter who has met her where she's at. They are worth the cost - because they have given me peace of mind where I didn't have it before.

I can’t recommend Green Paws enough! The office staff are so helpful, flexible, and responsive, the care team is so caring, transparent, and thorough - it’s been so great to have people I can completely trust take care of our pets while we’re at work or away for the weekend. Our pets have lots of needs and everyone has followed our detailed instructions so well. We’re moving and we’re going to miss everyone at Green Paws so much!

It saddens me greatly to write this review. Just a month ago, I would've enthusiastically recommended Green Paws. After several prior house sitting experiences, we felt confident we'd found a team who understood compassionate, professional, and reliable care for our beloved pets. Unfortunately, we have never been more wrong. Our most recent experience with a new sitter, Stacey, completely destroyed that trust and left us feeling shaken and distressed.

This was our 4-month-old golden retriever puppy’s first time away from us. He's a well-socialized pup who attends daycare regularly and has never had behavioral issues with people or dogs. We provided Stacey with clear, trainer-informed instructions and offered support throughout the stay, because yes, caring for a young puppy can be challenging and annoying! But rather than follow our guidance, Stacey routinely ignored it and treated him in ways that were deeply upsetting, unprofessional, and in our opinion, inconsistent with appropriate puppy care.

We have Ring cameras in our home, which we disclosed in advance, and here we witnessed every pet parent's nightmare: Stacey repeatedly raising her voice at our puppy and using profanities directed at him; physically handling him harshly by the collar, including at one point in a visible moment of anger when she dragged him across the room, forced him into his crate and slammed the door when he was engaging in developmentally normal nipping (confirmed by our professional trainer after her review); using his crate as punishment multiple times despite us explicitly asking her not to do so; scolding him for just one accident in the house the entire visit; using unfamiliar or incorrect commands and then reacting with visible frustration when he didn't comply; slamming items down on our tables in frustration; audible muttering about the instructions we provided. We were surprised and deeply concerned by what appeared to be a lack of patience and understanding of normal puppy development, behaviors, and handling techniques.

What we hoped would bring peace of mind based on our prior experiences with Green Paws turned into a weekend of constant anxiety. We felt trapped. Ultimately, we told Stacey we were coming home early even though we were not because we were able to find a friend who kindly stepped in at the last minute to stay with our puppy until we returned. Thankfully our puppy was not physically injured, but he smelled like he had expressed his anal glands - given what he endured that weekend with Stacey, that unfortunately did not come as a surprise.

The day of our return, we provided Green Paws with a detailed account of all of this information, including video clips depicting the above concerns. To their credit, they refunded the full amount for this visit as well as an upcoming booking, waiving their usual cancellation policy, and as we requested, they ensured Stacey would not have access to our information or to contact us again. Pet parents deserve to know that this individual may still be assigned to care for their animals. We would encourage anyone considering this company, and especially anyone scheduled with Stacey, to ask careful questions and clarify expectations. We hope no one else has to go through what we did.

Of note, we have carefully reviewed Google’s posted policies and confirmed that this review complies with all stated guidelines.
